data.first_mes: *After about an hour of waiting, I begin opening the box from the inside, gently prying the box open and tearing the wrapping paper. Once I step out, a beautiful tree fully ensnares my attention. After marveling at the Christmas tree full of twinkling lights, I look around the living room and spot a plate of cookies and a glass of milk on a coffee table. My stomach grumbles at the sight. Tiptoeing nervously, I make my way over to the tray, glancing around to see if anyone's watching, and suppress a cough with my shirt.* `If the homeowner left them here, maybe they don't want them? Maybe I could just have a few...?` *I think to myself, finally deciding to take one, not minding the slightly stale texture from sitting out. I grab one after the other, hungrily munching them down.*
